workspaces.Name: Design
workspaces.Tip: Solid, surface, freeform, NURBS and sheet metal modeling.

workspaces.Name: Drawing
workspaces.Tip: Edit engineering drawing sheets, views, dimensions and annotations.

workspaces.Name: ECAD
workspaces.Tip: Electronic boards, component envelopes and enclosure integration.

workspaces.Name: Scan
workspaces.Tip: Clean up meshes, and rebuild scans as CAD. Print preparation is in CAM.

workspaces.Name: CAE
workspaces.Tip: Static structures, thermal conduction, natural frequencies, mechanism kinematics and motion, and pipe-flow calculations.

workspaces.Name: Assemble
workspaces.Tip: Bottom-up assemblies: insert parts, joint them, test the motion and animate it.

workspaces.Name: Render
workspaces.Tip: Make realistic pictures: lighting, background and quality.

workspaces.Name: CAM
workspaces.Tip: CNC machining and stock review, FDM preparation and resin cavity checks. Export to your preferred slicer.

workspaces.Name: Mold
workspaces.Tip: Make a two-part mold from a block and the part inside it, split where you choose and shown exploded; check draft and sections with Tooling.

workspaces.Name: Script
workspaces.Tip: Write Python that builds and changes models. The editor sits beside the model; everything a script makes is one undo step.

tools.label: Home
tools.description: The home screen: your workspace folder, recent parts, new part.

tools.label: New
tools.description: Start an empty document.

tools.label: Open
tools.description: Open an Prism or STEP file.

tools.label: Save
tools.description: Save the document.

tools.label: Save As
tools.description: Save under a new name.

tools.label: Import File
tools.description: Bring in a file by its type: STEP, IGES, BREP, DXF (as a sketch), STL, OBJ, PLY or 3MF.

tools.label: Import STEP
tools.description: Bring a STEP (.step/.stp) model into the document.

tools.label: Import Mesh
tools.description: Bring in a scan or print file: STL, OBJ, PLY or 3MF.

tools.label: Export STEP
tools.description: Write all visible objects as a STEP file.

tools.label: Export IGES
tools.description: Write all visible solids and surfaces as an IGES file (.iges).

tools.label: Export BREP
tools.description: Write the exact geometry as an Open CASCADE BREP file.

tools.label: Export glTF
tools.description: Write a binary glTF (.glb) for viewers, games and the web: Y-up, metres, one colour per body. Exports the selection, or everything if nothing is selected.

tools.label: Export DXF
tools.description: Write the selected sketches (or every visible one) as a DXF of lines, circles and arcs, for laser, waterjet and CNC.

tools.label: Export 3MF
tools.description: Write a 3MF file for printing: keeps each body separate, in millimetres. Exports the selection, or everything if nothing is selected.

tools.label: Export STL
tools.description: Write a triangle mesh (STL). Exports the selection, or everything if nothing is selected.

tools.label: Export OBJ
tools.description: Write a Wavefront OBJ mesh.

tools.label: Export PLY
tools.description: Write a PLY mesh.

tools.label: Object
tools.description: Pick whole bodies, surfaces and curves.

tools.label: Face
tools.description: Pick individual faces.

tools.label: Edge
tools.description: Pick individual edges.

tools.label: Vertex
tools.description: Select cage vertices (1 while editing Freeform).

tools.label: Rectangle
tools.description: Drag a rectangle. Left to right takes only what is completely inside; right to left takes whatever it touches. Click the button again to go back to clicking.

tools.label: Lasso
tools.description: Draw around what you want to select. Whatever the loop touches is picked.

tools.label: Paint
tools.description: Drag a stroke across the model: whatever the stroke crosses is selected. Click the button again to go back to clicking.

tools.label: Invert
tools.description: Select everything that is not selected. Faces and edges invert within the bodies you picked from, so you can pick a few to leave out, invert, and have the rest. With nothing selected it selects everything.

tools.label: Through
tools.description: Select through the part: rectangle and lasso also pick faces, edges and bodies hidden behind others, on both sides. Alt-click steps through what is under the pointer, front to back. Turns X-ray display on while it is active.

tools.label: Gizmo
tools.description: Position and bind the gizmo; adjust its handles and snapping.

tools.label: Point
tools.description: Place datum points: click a face, edge or empty space, and keep clicking to add more.

tools.label: Axis
tools.description: Place a datum axis on an edge or face normal; empty space uses the work-plane normal.

tools.label: Plane
tools.description: Place a datum plane on a face, plane or the work plane.

tools.label: Create Sketch
tools.description: Draw constrained curves on one or more planes in space. G positions the drawing gizmo; E edits curves; N looks normal.

tools.label: Construction Plane
tools.description: Make planes: offset (one or a whole stack), angled, midway, square to a curve, or through three points. Sketch on them or use them as references.

tools.label: Curve
tools.description: Click points in space. The curve passes through them, or is pulled toward them as control points.

tools.label: Curve from Data
tools.description: Make a curve from formulas of t or a table of x,y,z points typed, pasted or read from a file.

tools.label: Intersection Curve
tools.description: The curve where two planes, faces, surfaces or bodies cross, or the shared 3D curve of two flat curves on different planes.

tools.label: Project
tools.description: Drop curves onto a surface, straight or by pulling to the nearest point.

tools.label: Draw on Surface
tools.description: Click points on any surface, surface body, freeform form or NURBS surface. The curve follows the surface, over edges onto neighbouring faces.

tools.label: Isocurves
tools.description: Pull curves of constant U or V out of a surface.

tools.label: Contour
tools.description: Slice a body into evenly spaced section curves.

tools.label: Fillet / Chamfer
tools.description: Round or cut the corners of a flat curve or sketch.

tools.label: Offset Curve
tools.description: Copy a flat curve parallel to itself.

tools.label: Blend Curve
tools.description: Join two curves with a curve that keeps their position, direction or bend.

tools.label: Join
tools.description: Join curves that touch end to end into one.

tools.label: Explode
tools.description: Break a curve or sketch into its segments.

tools.label: Extract Edges
tools.description: Copy selected edges as independent curves, joining touching edges and keeping the source body.

tools.label: Trim Curve
tools.description: Keep part of a curve, or cut it into pieces.

tools.label: Extend Curve
tools.description: Grow a curve past its end, keeping it smooth.

tools.label: Rebuild Curve
tools.description: Redraw a curve with a chosen number of points.

tools.label: Points Along Curve
tools.description: Place points at equal distances along a curve; keep the curve intact and report its length.
